carmen.ops: RCA live: https://internal.redwood/rca/2976543210. Short summary: a schema mismatch in the rollout pipeline caused a subset of model configs to fail validation, leading to degraded routing for about 14 minutes. We rolled the change back and revalidated. Action table at the bottom. Owners please ack by EOD.

status-bot: Timeline: 21:10 rollout -> 21:16 validation errors -> 21:20 partial rollback -> 21:24 full rollback -> 21:28 service normal. Logs and diffs attached.

lee.eng: I'll take "pipeline schema strictness". Plan: add schema versioning + fail-fast in CI, and an integration test against canonical configs. ETA: Wed 2024-05-08.

anita.prod: I'll draft the CSM-facing blurb, keeping it concise and non-technical. Will share draft here for quick review.

ryan.sre: I'll own "post-deploy smoke + routing check". Will add a short synthetic check and an alert if routing mismatch >3%. Checkpoint: Mon 2024-05-06 09:30 PT.

tara.cs: FYI I saw 3 support tickets during the window; I'll include the RCA link in responses.

carmen.ops: Office hours to review RCA & actions: Thu 2024-05-02 10:00 PT. Please post PRs and screenshots back here so I can close items after one-week watch. React with :white_check_mark: to accept ownership.

lee.eng: \u2705
